verdict.rationale: Recurly documents invoices as the central transaction record, issues a separate credit invoice for every credit, and lets ops edit invoice details such as customer notes, PO numbers, and terms, which covers memos and some custom fields. Much of the story is not evidenced: the pack says nothing about sequential or compliant numbering, receipts, or automatic delivery of these documents to customers. Missing for 10: sequential/compliant invoice numbering, receipts, automatic delivery to customers, general custom fields beyond notes/PO/terms, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, the platform generates compliant invoices, credit notes, and receipts — sequential numbering, custom fields, memos — delivered to customers automatically

citations.quote: invoices are the central record of every transaction between you and your customers — detailing what was purchased, the price, and the payment status.
Credit invoices give every credit its own distinct invoice — separate from charge invoices
Modify invoice details post-issuance — including account notes, due dates, PO numbers, customer notes, and terms — to keep records accurate.
